affected_subject.reason: Identifies RiskEngine.twapEMA() and its incorrect tuple unpacking of OraclePack.getEMAs().

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete operation: positional tuple assignment in twapEMA() misassigns eonsEMA/slowEMA/fastEMA from getEMAs() return values.

direct_effect.reason: Computes (6*slow+3*fast+spot)/10 instead of intended 0.6*fast+0.3*slow+0.1*eons, yielding wrong TWAP tick consumed downstream.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected-vs-actual numeric relation: intended weighted formula vs actual formula, plus inconsistency with isSafeMode()'s correct unpacking.

summary: Report specifies affected function, the misordered tuple unpacking trigger, the resulting wrong TWAP computation, and the expected-vs-actual formula mismatch, enabling a grounded P/I/V derivation.
